#  35504 - Integrated Project in Grid Operation of Large Scale Virtual Power Plants Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **35504 - module is no longer offered from WS 2010/11**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Integrated Project in Grid Operation of Large Scale Virtual Power Plants**  |  
|  Integriertes Projekt zum Netzbetrieb mit großen virtuellen Kraftwerken   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Bitsch, Rainer 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  10   |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Integration and operation of Large Scale Virtual RES/DG Power Plants  |  
| Contents:  | Structure and characteristics of LSVPP, requirements of grid connection, necessary power automation/communication/information systems, operational aspects and opportunities with respect to energy market approach  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Decentralized generation, storage, grid assets, network planning and protection, power automation and information systems  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 10 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 150 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Scripts, reference books concerning decentralized energy systems  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Project report and presentation  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 01.10.2008 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
